message: 結成!!　流星クルセイダース

name: Eddie
message: 「Alright, sorry, but I'm gonna head to Prier.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's what you get for oversleeping when you're not used to it!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, why don't you share a little of your lunch?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mine... it's probably better if he doesn't~ Today's a masterpiece, he'd pass out if he ate it~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guess I've got no choice! I shall share my handmade rice balls with you, Lady Nanaka style!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Really!? Then in return, I'll give you my--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Satchin, you don't have to give him anything. Synn says he'd rather skip lunch.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? I haven't even said anything yet?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't remember raising anyone who repays kindness with evil!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why does everyone just assume it's milk!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Because that's the only thing you have, right?」
Still, this is trouble. I'm the Student Council President and I can't even get my hands on lunch.

name: Synn
message: 「That's right! As long as I have this...」

name: Synn
message: 「No way... Doesn't becoming Student Council President mean free meals at the cafeteria...?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I think that'd be way too much abuse of power~」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmmgh, at least one roll of bread! No, shouldn't a single glass of juice be fine?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, exactly. That unholy liquid is more than enough for you.」

name: Synn
message: 「This has got to be a mistake. And after I became Student Council President, too...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why don't you go ask the previous Student Council President then?」
Ugh... It's really hard to talk to her right now.
That said, settling for just milk is brutal.

name: Nanaka
message: 「The month just started and you're already spending all the money you have?」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll be fine. Tomorrow will surely be an all-you-can-eat feast.」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll work out somehow! I am the Student Council President, after all!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah, let me guess--the extra-large cabbage bun~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look! Stop blabbering and go buy it already!! My lunch box is gonna get lukewarm!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I think it's already gone cold long ago~」
On the way back after successfully securing the extra-large cabbage bun--

name: Sacchin
message: 「If you're gonna ask, now's your only chance~」

name: Synn
message: 「W-well, that's... I mean, I do, but...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then we're on the same page! Riiia-senpaaai!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yelling out loud like that, embarrassing yourself as usual~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What're you talking about? She won't hear me if I'm not loud!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'm pretty sure she can hear you without going that far~」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... so I'd appreciate it if you could tone it down a bit.\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry! It's nothing at all, seriously!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! I went through all the trouble of calling her for you! Why're you chickening out now?!」

name: Ria
message: 「We'll talk about that... after school, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's weird. My body just naturally started moving on its own to run away from Nanaka--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come to think of it, you were alone with Ria-senpai yesterday, weren't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then why are you running!? Hey! Wait up~~~!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You two sure are full of energy~」

name: Synn
message: 「Haa, haa. I think I managed to shake her off...」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, well... I was running away like crazy and ended up here...」

name: Misa
message: 「Running away? You must have done something bad, then. Good grief, I wish you'd show a little more awareness as a Student Council officer.」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't do anything bad! That's not why I came here, it's just, well...」

name: Misa
message: 「You can tell just by looking. I'm eating lunch.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you like it, you should look like you're enjoying it more.」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that really all you're having for lunch?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes, it is! Got a problem with that?」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... So you're just like me, Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「How on earth... could this be saving money?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then why? You'll never grow big and strong with a meal like that.」

name: Misa
message: 「Wait, where did you even get that milk?! Just drink it yourself!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, it's fine. I have another one for myself.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh, now I'm getting hungry too. Mind if I eat here?」
Last year's meeting minutes were left on the desk.
The sticky-noted pages were filled entirely with areas where the Student Council's issues had still not been resolved.

name: Synn
message: 「If she came here to work on Student Council stuff, she could have just said so... Guess I got in her way.」
Since it's right here, I might as well take a look.
Let's see... As one of the Seven Wonders of the Academy, the Chairman's presence is--

name: Nanaka
message: 「I figured if you're the Student Council President, you'd end up here.」

name: Synn
message: 「To think my title would work against me... Ugh. Still, you took your time getting here, didn't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, hurry up and finish yours too.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're not going to interrogate me about earlier?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Once my stomach got full, I stopped caring.」
「I guessed she would mostly likely be here, but... was I mistaken?」

name: Synn
message: 「She had a naginata bag on her back... Naginata Club, maybe?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「'Sister', huh? How old-school! I want someone to call me that too.」

name: Synn
message: 「*munch munch, gulp gulp* Nothing goes better with an extra-large cabbage bun than milk. Want some too, Sister?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, don't be shy, drink it all up, little brother.」
